interface.signature: def countVertex(N: int, edges: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> int:

preconditions.description: The number of nodes N must be between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The number of edges must be exactly N-1, forming a valid tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must consist of two node indices between 1 and N inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(len(selected) for selected in all_possible_coverings(edges))
postconditions.description: The function returns the minimum number of nodes required to cover all edges, where a node covers all edges incident to it.

postconditions.expression: all(any(u in selected or v in selected for u, v in edges) for selected in all_possible_coverings(edges) if len(selected) == return_value)
postconditions.description: Every edge must be covered by at least one selected node in the minimal covering set.
